_comment: N6 of docs/2026-09-14_specific_force_control_design.md §12 — the specific force's invariance WITH a restoring force. WHY: N3 (specific force) collapsed the per-class n_x bias to the truth's own spread on both seeds but failed the heavy − B737 speed gap and tripped the straight-in FDE veto (887 / 885 m p50; the last 5 km flown 4.4 m/s slow) — the missing drag feedback, dV'/dV = 0. A speed loop restores dV'/dV = −1/τ_V on every airframe. GATES (N3's instrument, docs/literature/control_normalization/measurements/per_class_readout.py on each arm's pred_val beside its twin's): the per-class n_x bias range toward the truth's 0.0045 g (N3 passed it); the heavy − B737 speed-bias gap closing (N3 failed it); the straight-in FDE p50 back inside the twins' seed spread (N3 failed it). VETO: pooled ADE worse than its twin by more than the ~125 m seed line. READING: all three where N3 passed one ⇒ the invariant needed the restoring force.
